title: Glovebox at a glance
subtitle: What the code does today: one MCP service an agent can connect to, with no tools and no data sources yet

evidence.note: Only an MCP client in the acceptance test connects today; no real agent integration is in the code, so this node is inferred.
MCPServer named glovebox; no tool is registered, so the tool list is empty.
The client reaches the service at /mcp over Streamable HTTP.
